articles.title: 007 First Light Is Getting Free DLC Later This Week
articles.summary: 007 First Light is getting new, free DLC later this week. IO Interactive has teased the new DLC via a short video on its socials, confirming it will arrive on Thursday, October 2. The DLC will be free, but as of right now, IO is remaining tight-lipped about what it will include.
body: This is expected to include a new TacSim mission featuring the Aston Martin Valhalla, which is used near the end of the game as part of a massive set piece. Given the extensive wait, it seems hard to imagine this will be just a short, single TacSim mission. This may add some other items that were revealed as part of a larger roadmap for the game, such as new game+, new gadgets, and other missions and content.

We'll just have to sit tight and wait to see what exactly is in store, though. 007 First Light is also set to get a new story DLC centered around Bawama, the pirate king warlord played by Lenny Kravitz. There's no firm release date for that content, though it's expected to be a premium add-on rather than a free update like what's coming later this week.

articles.title: Jennifer Lawrence to Star in Zach Cregger’s Sci-Fi Thriller The Flood
articles.summary: Zach Cregger’s next movie, a science fiction thriller called The Flood, is set to release in theaters on August 11, 2028. Cregger is writing, producing, and directing the film, which will star Jennifer Lawrence, as confirmed by Variety on September 29, 2026. Warner Bros.
body: Warner Bros. and New Line Cinema are slated to distribute the movie, which is being produced by Amblin Entertainment and Vertigo Entertainment's Roy Lee and Miri Yoon.

Thus far, other cast members and specific plot details have been kept secret, but Cregger has given us a few insights into what we can expect from his forthcoming sci-fi flick. Speaking to Men’s Health in mid-September, Cregger revealed that the movie is 'similar' to Stanley Kubrick’s 2001: A Space Odyssey.

“I'm not comparing [The Flood] to 2001, because I think 2001 is a true masterpiece in every sense of the word. But there's a bizarreness to that movie that's really undeniable, and it's also a horror movie. I think 2001 is a really thrilling horror movie about human nature, and obviously about artificial intelligence, but it asks big questions. And I think, in that way, there's some similarity with Flood,” he said.

Based on these remarks, we can safely assume that The Flood has something to do with AI, human nature, and big-picture concepts — but one thing he confirmed was that The Flood is very specifically not a horror movie.

articles.title: Obsession Director Curry Barker's Next Film, Anything But Ghosts, Gets May 2027 Theatrical Release
articles.summary: Anything But Ghosts comes to the silver screen on May 7, 2027. The film takes place in the same universe as Obsession, but is classified as a horror-comedy that follows a different cast of characters entirely — though they also go through some seriously spooky stuff.
body: Obsession director Curry Barker’s next film, Anything But Ghosts, is coming to theaters next year.

Barker’s next flick stars Bryce Dallas Howard, Aaron Paul, Violet McGraw, Chris Reinache, and Cooper Tomlinson, who notably played Bear’s best friend, Ian, in Obsession, as well as Barker himself. Anything But Ghosts centers around two fake paranormal investigators who are finally confronted with some actual, real-life ghosts (or would that be ‘real-afterlife’ ghosts?), causing things to “spiral wildly and terrifyingly out of control,” as per an official press release.

Speaking on a June episode of Raiders of the Lost Podcast, Tomlinson confirmed that he and Curry are playing the two phony ghost hunters, and described the film as “if Key and Peele walked into Hereditary.”

“It’s a buddy comedy, you know, about these two guys, and it turns really scary,” he said. “You know, it’s about these con artist ghost hunters who encounter real ghosts, and then they have to step up and be the thing that they promised this family.”

articles.title: Alleged WoW: Forever Survey Teases 11 New Classes, Including Some Deep Cuts
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's new take on classic Azeroth is opening the door to all kinds of new ideas in the old-school version of Blizzard's MMORPG, and new classes look to be one of them.
body: Blizzard, of course, has added a total of four new classes over the last two decades to the modern version of WoW: Death Knight, Monk, Demon Hunter, and Evoker. But an alleged leaked survey pushed to select WoW players via Blizzard's Battle.net launcher is now asking about potential new classes for WoW: Forever, the recently revealed third version of the MMO that will introduce new quests, zones, and content to the "vanilla" version of WoW.

Three of the new classes would essentially be "new," old-school versions of existing WoW classes like Demon Hunter, Monk, and Death Knight. Considering how fast-paced classes like Monk and Demon Hunter are in the modern version of the game, their Forever counterparts would likely feel significantly different.

articles.title: GTA 6 Won’t Spoof Disney World, And That’s Too Bad
articles.summary: GTA 6 will not include its own spoof on one of Florida's most iconic venues: Walt Disney World. I adore all things Disney, including the parks. But I also appreciate and enjoy Rockstar's penchant for sarcasm and making fun of things. And Disney World? There is a lot to poke fun at.
body: Game Informer asked Rockstar if Florida's central region, including Orlando and its tourist destinations like Walt Disney World and Universal Studios, would be represented in GTA 6 in some form, and Jack McPherson said they wouldn't. However, McPherson stressed that GTA 6 will offer the "full Florida experience" in numerous other ways.

“We have to constantly evaluate the diversity of landscapes, towns, structures, landmarks, vistas, plant species, rock formations and everything else before we work with design and narrative to distill a list down that best works with and serves the game’s needs. So, while we may not have those exact locations, everything we have is geared to getting that full Florida experience!”
GTA 6 also won't feature SeaWorld or Florida's iconic "Space Coast," featuring Cape Canaveral's historic launch pad.

I am not too surprised by any of this, though, considering GTA 6 takes place in Vice City, a stand-in for Miami, which is a four-hour, 230-mile drive from Orlando. I know GTA 6 is going to be a big game-- featuring the biggest game map Rockstar ever made --but I never expected the map to run all the way up to Orlando.

articles.title: 10 Game Cancellations That Are Still Devastating Years Later
articles.summary: Sometimes, it’s fun to think about the great games that might have been — until they were canceled without ever getting the chance to make their mark. Most of the time, we just shrug our shoulders and move on, because that’s life. But sometimes, we mourn the wasted potential.
body: Some of those canceled games might have fought the odds and disappointed us anyway, like Duke Nukem Forever. Others might just as easily have become massive hits, if only they had been allocated additional time and resources. In that regard, they’re a bit like Schrodinger’s cat. With both possible outcomes in mind, here are the 10 canceled games we’re still upset about years later. They could have been contenders!

articles.title: CoD: Modern Warfare 4 Brings Back The Franchise’s Most Chaotic And Divisive Multiplayer Map
articles.summary: Activision has confirmed that one of the Call of Duty franchise's most notorious maps, Shipment, is coming back for this year's Modern Warfare 4. After fans spotted it in the newly released trailer for MW4's PC version, the Call of Duty account directly confirmed its return with a dedicated post.
body: Shipment, which debuted in 2007's Modern Warfare 4, is a tiny map filled with shipping containers that players can dash through. Due to its small size, players can get wiped out in their spawns easily, and the action generally is extremely chaotic. Some people love the map. Others hate it.
Shipment's return in 2026's MW4 is no big surprise, as it's been featured in numerous Modern Warfare games over the years. It also showed up in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Mobile.
While Activision has confirmed that Shipment will return in MW4, the company did not say if it will be among the 12 6v6 maps available at launch, or if it will be released sometime later.

For those who enjoy Shipment, its inclusion in MW4 is just the latest piece of good news. Before this, Activision confirmed that MW4 will finally fix how double XP tokens work and the dreaded "update requires restart" notice is going away. Additionally, MW4 will usher in a feature in Warzone that lets you avoid seeing all those wacky skins. The game also has a brand-new, Counter-Strike style mode.

articles.title: WoW: Forever Players Are Up In Arms Over Streamer Not Being Banned For Illegal Gold
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is opening up old wounds when it comes to Blizzard's actions (or in many players' views, inaction) against bots and real-money gold buying, with a recent incident involving a popular streamer becoming a flashpoint for the MMORPG.
body: WoW Classic streamer Ziqo was recently seen on stream accepting large sums of gold from strangers in the lead up to a $100,000 WoW: Forever beta dueling tournament on October 17. In a clip in which he was traded 380 gold from a level one character (a huge amount in WoW Classic/Forever, particularly in a beta that's only been out for two weeks), Ziqo can be heard saying there's no way that amount of gold is "natty" but accepts the trade anyways. In another clip, he accepts 175 gold from a different level one character named El Delivery.

The community immediately saw huge cause for concern. Not only did gold buying already appear to be alive and well in the Forever beta after Blizzard previously said it would be more aggressive in taking action against gold buyers, but the streamer looked to be effectively buying his way to victory in the upcoming tournament. With that amount of gold, Ziqo would be able to essentially buy anything he needed in the lead up to the tournament, giving him an advantage. The WoW Classic subreddit became aflame with calls for Blizzard to take action.

articles.title: Valve Rolls Out Huge Update for Hero Shooter Deadlock as Game Hits All-Time Peak
articles.summary: Valve rolled out a massive update for its lane-based multiplayer hero shooter Deadlock on Tuesday and in doing so helped boost the still-kind-of-unannounced game to its biggest concurrent audience to date.
body: Shortly after Deadlock 's new update went live, player counts surged past 228,000 concurrents, an all-time high for the game, according to SteamDB.

Alongside the City Never Sleeps update, Valve also issued an update on the game's overall development, which appears to be nowhere near completion. After January's Old Gods New Blood update for Deadlock, Valve said, "we felt that there was still a good amount of work we wanted to do on the core game itself before we moved onto more polish phases of the game development (like updating older hero artwork)."
The Deadlock team says it's been working on a number of features in parallel, some of which are included in City Never Sleeps.

articles.title: Deadlock's gigantic new update gives its city a spooky new coat of paint and debuts 6 new heroes, including the one and only Rat King
articles.summary: The cursed city where Deadlock's battles take place just got even spookier than it already was in the City Never Sleeps update. Valve's second major overhaul for the invite-only MOBA marks another major step in its pseudo-early access development, giving it a much stronger visual identity than it…
body: Deadlock's entire map has been redecorated into three distinct themes: a bright city center, a haunted university, and a shadowy stock exchange. All the buildings and creeps that inhabit each street have been redesigned to fit in. There are pickle jars with hands growing out of them lurking in the heart of the map, sentient stacks of books in the right lane, and slimy trashbag monsters in the left lane.

Squeezed between it all are four districts with their own identities, like a theater district infested with literal stage hands pulling the strings on steampunk-style automatons. Atop the Chinatown district is a bell tower where teams can fight over a fountain of souls to try to get a currency advantage in a tight match. Even the wooden crates that players smash for resources are now padlocked and bolted shut.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 surges to its highest Steam concurrent player-count ever, following Remastered edition's release
articles.summary: The Witcher 3 's newly released Remastered edition has dramatically rekindled interest in the 11-year-old role-playing game, which is currently enjoying its highest concurrent player-count on Steam ever.
body: As of the time of writing, nearly 120,000 people are playing The Witcher 3 on Steam, making it the ninth most-played game on the PC platform. That of course does not include numbers from the likes of GOG and the Epic Games Store, where it's also being sold, nor the players on PlayStation, Switch 2, and Xbox.

According to Steam data-tracking website SteamDB, that's the highest concurrent player-count The Witcher 3 has ever had - higher than at its launch in 2015 (a high of 92K), and higher than the game's previous peak of 103K in January 2020, when Netflix's Witcher show was at its most popular. The other notable peak was 89K in December 2022, when the next-gen update dropped.

With a playerbase of 65 million, there's a large community to excite, but it's a reminder of how much pulling-power CD Projekt Red's fantasy RPG has, all the same. And as America wakes up and downloads the update, the question is how high can the numbers go?

body: Doctrine can manipulate life itself to heal allies and damage enemies with the help of his Eternal Scepter.
From the trailer's official description: Dodge incoming fire with his Shrouded Momentum ability, and send out your Invigorating Drones to an ally for increased attack speed and healing.

Doctrine’s Infuse takes things to the next level by adding extra power to whichever ability he uses next, like gaining free-flight when infusing his Shrouded Momentum or piercing damage when infusing his next Eternal Scepter attack. Finally, unleash his Ultimate, Deliverance, to grant allies overhealth while reducing the maximum health of your enemies.
